tickets.text: I exported stock movement data twice from the application using the same filters, but restricted one export to a specific product and the other to a different product. The total units shown in each export are different from each other. Can you help me understand why the two exports show different unit totals when all other filter settings are the same?

I exported stock movements data twice using the same filters except for the event_day. When I filter to event_day 2026-09-14 the total units comes out as 923, but when I filter to event_day 2026-09-15 it comes out as 772. All other filters like warehouse_id and product_id are the same in both exports. Why would the totals be different between these two days?
